name: screenrecorder-monorepo
description: ScreenRecorder - Browser Extension with Native FFmpeg Processing

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace=apps/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build:protocol && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:protocol && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/verify-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/package-extension.mjs
